$description: Dovetail design tokens. Source of truth in the DTCG format (Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10). CSS in tokens/**.css is generated from this file; see tools/README.md.

primitive.$description: Tier 1. Raw values, no meaning. Never referenced by a component.

secondary.$description: A second brand hue. Ships with the violet values; a theme replaces it wholesale.
The small UI voice: labels, buttons, badges, tabs and eyebrows.

tracking.$description: Letter spacing as a multiple of the current font size. DTCG dimension allows px and rem only, so tracking is a number and the CSS generator emits it in em.

opacity.$description: Tier 1. Raw opacity steps, 0 to 1 by tenths. Components read the semantic roles, never these.

shadow.$description: Tier 1. Two-layer shadow recipes: a tight contact shadow plus a soft ambient one. Single-layer shadows read as flat stickers at larger sizes.

semantic.$description: Tier 2. Purpose-driven. The themeable layer — a brand theme overrides these and nothing else. No value words permitted in names.

action-brand.$description: Brand-coloured primary action. Nothing reads it by default; a theme opts in by pointing surface.action at it.

on-action.$description: Paired with surface.action. Always ship the pair; contrast is verified on the pair, not the parts.

on-scrim.$description: Text over a darkened photograph. Stays light in dark mode.

on-scrim-strong.$description: Pure white over a photograph or video, for large type.

on-scrim-brand.$description: A light brand step for a title over a darkened photograph or video.

wordmark.$description: The wordmark. Ink by default; a theme points it at a brand text role.

headline.$description: Display and heading text. Ink by default; a theme points it at a brand text role.

link-brand.$description: Brand-coloured link, the opt-in twin of text.link.

layout.$description: How closely the two things either side of a gap belong together. Four layers, each with a stack and an inline gap, moved together by the layout's character: tight, balanced (the values here) or open.

text-eyebrow.$description: An eyebrow and the heading it introduces.

text-subcopy.$description: A heading (with its eyebrow) and the lead under it.

text-paragraph.$description: One paragraph or body item and the next.

module-padding.$description: Above and below a module's content. --dt-space-section at the default layout.

module-gap.$description: Between a module's own parts: header, content, call to action.

scale.$description: Multiplies every layer in Stack and Inline. 1 on a page; a surface drawn at another size, such as a social artboard, sets it once.

module-padding-sm.$description: The small step of a module's padding above or below: --dt-space-section-compact at the default layout. Moves with the layout's character.

module-padding-lg.$description: A spacious step, for a band that wants more room.

module-padding-xl.$description: The largest step, for a statement band.

module-inset.$description: Padding inside a band set in from the page edges.

page-width.$description: The content column every page and section shares. Configure's Page width moves it.

page-width-wide.$description: A hero or a gallery that still wants a margin.

page-gutter.$description: The room between the page column and the screen's edge: --dt-space-gutter at the default layout. Moves with the layout's character.

touch-target.$description: Minimum interactive hit area on touch surfaces.

media-min.$description: The least height for a card with a picture behind it.

typography.$description: Tier 2. Complete type roles — family, size, line height, weight and tracking travel together. letterSpacing is resolved to rem here because DTCG dimension has no em unit; the authored tracking scale lives in primitive.tracking.

opacity.$description: Tier 2. How see-through a layer is, by purpose. Four roles; opaque is the default and has no token. Disabled controls and muted art read through these so a theme can tune them in one place.

disabled.$description: A control that can't be used right now.

muted.$description: Secondary art and decoration that shouldn't compete with content.

strong.$description: A layer over content that should still show what's beneath.

elevation.$description: Tier 2. Elevation is a z-order vocabulary, not a shadow menu: pick the level that matches what the element is. Level 0 is flush with the page and carries no shadow, so it has no token here — use no shadow at all.

scrim.$description: Image scrims, dark in both modes.

bottom.$value: linear-gradient(to top, color-mix(in oklab, {primitive.color.neutral.950} 80%, transparent), color-mix(in oklab, {primitive.color.neutral.950} 40%, transparent) 45%, transparent)

top.$value: linear-gradient(to bottom, color-mix(in oklab, {primitive.color.neutral.950} 80%, transparent), color-mix(in oklab, {primitive.color.neutral.950} 40%, transparent) 45%, transparent)

component.$description: Tier 3. Per-component escape hatches, authored only where a real override need exists (Button, Input, Card, Dialog, Table).
